title: A survey of the Schrödinger problem and some of its connections with optimal transport
authors: Christian Léonard

authors: Yongxin Chen, Tryphon T. Georgiou, Michele Pavon

authors: Marco Cuturi

title: Computational Optimal Transport
authors: G. Peyré, Marco Cuturi

authors: Valentin De Bortoli, James Thornton, J. Heng, A. Doucet

authors: T. Chen, Guan-Horng Liu, Evangelos A. Theodorou

title: Diffusion Bridge Mixture Transports, Schrödinger Bridge Problems and Generative Modeling
authors: Stefano Peluchetti

title: BM2: Coupled Schrödinger Bridge Matching
authors: Stefano Peluchetti
note: BM²：耦合的双向 bridge matching，单轮同时拟合两个方向。

title: Deep Generative Learning via Schrödinger Bridge
authors: Gefei Wang, Yuling Jiao, Qiang Xu, Yang Wang, Can Yang
note: 早期用 SB 做生成建模的工作：以数据分布为终端的 SB + 分数估计。

title: Solving Schrödinger Bridges via Maximum Likelihood
authors: Francisco Vargas, Pierre Thodoroff, Neil D. Lawrence, A. Lamacraft
note: 用最大似然（GP 回归 drift）求解 SB 的早期方法。

title: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
authors: Linqi Zhou, Aaron Lou, Samar Khanna, S. Ermon
note: DDBM：在 paired 端点之间定义 Doob h-transform 桥，统一 I²SB 类方法的训练/采样接口。

title: Aligned Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges
authors: Vignesh Ram Somnath, Matteo Pariset, Ya-Ping Hsieh, María Rodríguez Martínez, Andreas Krause, Charlotte Bunne

authors: Kaiwen Zheng, Guande He, Jianfei Chen, Fan Bao, Jun Zhu

authors: Clément Chadebec, O. Tasar, Sanjeev Sreetharan, Benjamin Aubin

title: Adversarial Schrödinger Bridge Matching
authors: N. Gushchin, Daniil Selikhanovych, S. Kholkin, Evgeny Burnaev, A. Korotin
note: ASBM：对抗式 D-IMF，用 GAN 判别器替代大量 NFE，像素空间少步 SB。

title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation via Neural Schrödinger Bridge
authors: Beomsu Kim, Gihyun Kwon, Kwanyoung Kim, Jong-Chul Ye
note: UNSB：神经 SB 做 unpaired 图像翻译，配对抗正则与 patch 判别。

title: Dual Diffusion Implicit Bridges for Image-to-Image Translation
authors: Xu Su, Jiaming Song, Chenlin Meng, S. Ermon
note: DDIB：两段 DDIM 拼接实现零样本图像翻译；两段 SB 拼接≠跨域 OT 的对照案例。

title: SDEdit: Guided Image Synthesis and Editing with Stochastic Differential Equations
authors: Chenlin Meng, Yutong He, Yang Song, Jiaming Song, Jiajun Wu et al.
note: SDEdit：噪声-去噪的零样本编辑基线。

title: Deep Momentum Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge
authors: T. Chen, Guan-Horng Liu, Molei Tao, Evangelos A. Theodorou
note: DMSB：带动量的多边缘 SB，用于单细胞等多时间点轨迹推断（3MSBM 的前身）。

title: Unbalanced Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge
authors: Matteo Pariset, Ya-Ping Hsieh, Charlotte Bunne, Andreas Krause, Valentin De Bortoli
note: Unbalanced DSB：允许质量不守恒（细胞增殖/死亡）的 SB 求解。

title: Feedback Schrödinger Bridge Matching
authors: Panagiotis Theodoropoulos, Nikolaos Komianos, Vincent Pacelli, Guan-Horng Liu, Evangelos A. Theodorou
note: Feedback SBM：把 SB 求解写成闭环反馈控制，提升多边缘/受约束场景的稳定性。

title: Stochastic Optimal Control for Diffusion Bridges in Function Spaces
authors: Byoungwoo Park, Jungwon Choi, Sungbin Lim, Juho Lee
note: 函数空间上的 diffusion bridge SOC（FAS 的函数空间前身）。

title: Categorical Schrödinger Bridge Matching
authors: Grigoriy Ksenofontov, A. Korotin
note: Categorical SBM：把 IMF 推到离散状态空间（categorical），文本/图/序列可用。

title: Discrete Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Graph Transformation
authors: Jun Hyeong Kim, Seonghwan Kim, Seokhyun Moon, Hyeongwoo Kim, Jeheon Woo, Woo Youn Kim
note: 离散 DSBM 做图变换（分子/图编辑）。

title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
authors: Y. Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le
note: Flow Matching：条件回归训练 ODE 生成模型；SB 视角下它是 σ→0 的确定性极限。

authors: Alexander Tong, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, G. Huguet, Yanlei Zhang, Jarrid Rector-Brooks et al.

title: Simulation-free Schrödinger bridges via score and flow matching
authors: Alexander Tong, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Kilian Fatras, Lazar Atanackovic, Yanlei Zhang et al.
note: [SF]²M：score + flow matching 的 simulation-free SB 求解器。

title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
authors: Xingchao Liu, Chengyue Gong, Qiang Liu
note: Rectified Flow：reflow 直线化 + 蒸馏到一步。

title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
authors: M. Albergo, N. Boffi, E. Vanden-Eijnden
note: Stochastic Interpolants：统一 flow / diffusion / bridge / SB 的插值框架。

title: Building Normalizing Flows with Stochastic Interpolants
authors: M. Albergo, E. Vanden-Eijnden
note: 随机插值短版：用插值构造 normalizing flow。

title: Optimal Flow Matching: Learning Straight Trajectories in Just One Step
authors: Nikita Kornilov, Alexander Gasnikov, A. Korotin
note: Optimal Flow Matching：一步得到直线 OT 轨迹。

title: Neural Optimal Transport
authors: Alexander Korotin, Daniil Selikhanovych, Evgeny Burnaev
note: Neural OT：对抗式弱 OT 求解器，SB/EOT 求解器的重要对照。

title: Adjoint Matching: Fine-tuning Flow and Diffusion Generative Models with Memoryless Stochastic Optimal Control
authors: Carles Domingo-Enrich, Michal Drozdzal, Brian Karrer, Ricky T. Q. Chen
note: Adjoint Matching：memoryless SOC + lean adjoint 回归做 reward 微调；AS/ASBS/DAM/FAS 的共同源头。

title: Training Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
authors: Kevin Black, Michael Janner, Yilun Du, Ilya Kostrikov, S. Levine
note: DDPO：把去噪过程当 MDP 用 policy gradient 微调扩散模型。

title: Path Integral Sampler: a stochastic control approach for sampling
authors: Qinsheng Zhang, Yongxin Chen
note: PIS：路径积分控制视角的扩散采样器，SOC 采样线源头。

title: Denoising Diffusion Samplers
authors: Francisco Vargas, Will Grathwohl, A. Doucet
note: DDS：去噪扩散采样器，KL 控制目标。

title: Transport meets Variational Inference: Controlled Monte Carlo Diffusions
authors: Francisco Vargas, Shreyas Padhy, Denis Blessing, Nikolas Nusken
note: CMCD：controlled Monte Carlo diffusions，把 transport 与变分推断统一。

title: Iterated Denoising Energy Matching for Sampling from Boltzmann Densities
authors: Tara Akhound-Sadegh, Jarrid Rector-Brooks, A. Bose, Sarthak Mittal, Pablo Lemos et al.
note: iDEM：simulation-free 能量采样竞品，Boltzmann 生成基准（DW4/LJ13/LJ55）。

title: NETS: A Non-Equilibrium Transport Sampler
authors: M. Albergo, Eric Vanden-Eijnden
note: NETS：非平衡 transport 采样器（annealed Langevin + 学习的 transport）。

title: Underdamped Diffusion Bridges with Applications to Sampling
authors: Denis Blessing, Julius Berner, Lorenz Richter, Gerhard Neumann
note: Underdamped Diffusion Bridges：欠阻尼动力学的 bridge 采样器。

title: Schrodinger Bridges Beat Diffusion Models on Text-to-Speech Synthesis
authors: Zehua Chen, Guande He, Kaiwen Zheng, Xu Tan, Jun Zhu
note: Bridge-TTS：用 SB 替代扩散做 TTS，少步下质量更优。

title: Schrödinger Bridge for Generative Speech Enhancement
authors: Ante Jukic, Roman Korostik, J. Balam, Boris Ginsburg
note: 语音增强的 SB 模型。

title: TrajectoryNet: A Dynamic Optimal Transport Network for Modeling Cellular Dynamics
authors: Alexander Tong, Jessie Huang, Guy Wolf, D. V. Dijk, Smita Krishnaswamy
note: TrajectoryNet：动态 OT 做单细胞轨迹推断的起点。

title: Branched Schrödinger Bridge Matching
authors: Sophia Tang, Yinuo Zhang, Alexander Tong, Pranam Chatterjee
note: BranchSBM：学多条分叉的速度场 + 各分支的质量增长网络，把 Unbalanced CondSOC 之和作为目标，刻画单细胞命运分叉与药物扰动的多模态终态；单分支 SBM 会模式塌缩。

title: Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching
note: MSBM：把 IMF 推广到多边缘约束——逐区间构造局部 SB 并共享全局控制参数化，保证中间边缘全部满足且轨迹连续；scRNA-seq 上与 3MSBM 同赛道。

title: Entering the Era of Discrete Diffusion Models: A Benchmark for Schrödinger Bridges and Entropic Optimal Transport
authors: Xavier Aramayo Carrasco, Grigoriy Ksenofontov, Aleksei Leonov, Iaroslav Koshelev, Alexander Korotin
note: 离散空间 SB 基准：构造有解析解的分布对以严格评测离散 SB 求解器；副产品 DLightSB / DLightSB-M 与 α-CSBM。离散 SB 第一次有了 ground truth。

title: Minimal-Action Discrete Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Peptide Sequence Design
note: MadSBM：把肽序列生成写成氨基酸编辑图上的受控 CTMC，参考过程来自冻结的 ESM-2 logits，学时变控制场得到低作用量传输路径；首次在 SB 生成模型上做离散 classifier guidance。

title: MDNS: Masked Diffusion Neural Sampler via Stochastic Optimal Control
note: MDNS：CTMC 随机最优控制视角训练离散神经采样器（Ising/Potts），用免微分的路径测度对齐目标与加权去噪交叉熵实现高维可扩展；与 DASBS 同属离散能量采样线。

title: Adjoint Matching through the Lens of the Stochastic Maximum Principle in Optimal Control
note: 从随机极大值原理（SMP）重推 Adjoint Matching：给出控制相关漂移/扩散与凸运行成本下的一般 Hamiltonian adjoint matching 目标，证明其一阶变分与原 SOC 目标一致；lean adjoint 是状态无关扩散下的特例。

title: Fine-Tuning Discrete Diffusion Models via Reward Optimization with Applications to DNA and Protein Design
note: DRAKES：对 masked 离散扩散做 reward 微调（Gumbel-Softmax 反传），目标是既像预训练分布又高 reward；DAM 的直接对照。

title: UniDB: A Unified Diffusion Bridge Framework via Stochastic Optimal Control
note: UniDB：把 diffusion bridge 写成 SOC 问题并给出闭式最优控制器；Doob h-transform 类桥（DDBM 等）是终端罚系数 →∞ 的特例，可调终端罚显著改善修复细节。

title: A Unified and Fast-Sampling Diffusion Bridge Framework via Stochastic Optimal Control (UniDB++)
note: UniDB++：为 UniDB 反向 SDE 推出精确闭式解 + 数据预测 + SDE-Corrector，免训练把采样步数减到 5–10（最多 20×），并在特定条件下退化为 DBIM。

title: Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Few-Step Visual Navigation
note: RSBM：证明条件速度场在整个熵正则 ε 谱上函数形式不变（SB ε=1 ↔ OT ε→0 同一网络），降低 ε 线性减小速度方差；视觉导航 3 步积分达 92% 成功率、94.5% 余弦相似度，无需蒸馏。

title: Sample from What You See: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Diffusion Bridge with Observation-Embedded Stochastic Differential Equation
note: BridgePolicy：把观测直接嵌入扩散 SDE，用 diffusion bridge 从'观测先验'而非高斯噪声出发采样动作；语义对齐器解决观测/动作维度异构；52 个仿真任务 + 5 个真机任务优于现有生成式策略。

title: A Unified Framework for Diffusion Bridge Problems: Flow Matching and Schrödinger Matching into One
note: 统一视角：FM、minibatch-OT FM、minibatch SB-FM 与 DSBM 都是同一 bridge 框架的特例；含对 IMF 与 CFM 的简明技术回顾。

title: Foundations of Schrödinger Bridges for Generative Modeling
note: 从 OT、随机控制与路径空间优化出发系统建立 SB 数学基础的教程式指南，聚焦动态表述与现代生成建模的联系（含 DSBM 专节）。

title: Notes on generative modeling: flow matching, diffusion, optimal transport and Schrödinger bridge
note: Peyresq 2026 暑期学校讲义：用 OT 把 flow matching、扩散与 SB 串成一条线，强调 IMF 收敛到熵最优耦合而 rectified flow 不收敛到 OT 耦合。
